english.title: Owner / master of ship which proceeds while failing to comply with regulation 19-1

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Merchant Shipping Safety of Navigation Regulations 2002

english.standardoffencewording:

(A)_[owner]_
(B)_[master]_

of **(..SPECIFY SHIP..), a ship to which regulation 19-1 of Chapter V of the Annex to the SOLAS convention applied and which

(C)_[proceeded]_
(D)_[attempted to proceed]_

(E)_[4]_

english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 6A of Schedule 4 to the Merchant Shipping (Safety of Navigation) Regulations 2002.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
owner/master of ship to which reg 19-1 applies
proceed on voyage / excursion
w/o complying with requirement in reg 19-1 para 4 / 5 / 6 / 7

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: (i) Paragraph 22 of Schedule 4 to the Merchant Shipping (Safety of Navigation) Regulations 2002 provides that it shall be a defence for a person charged under these Regulations to show that he took all reasonable steps to avoid the commission of the offence.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
